blocks.h2: How an Overhead Sewer System Works
blocks.body: In an overhead system, nothing in the basement drains directly into the sewer by gravity anymore. The floor drain and basement fixtures empty into a sealed pit. An [ejector pump](/elgin/ejector-pump) lifts the water to a pipe near the ceiling, a check valve keeps it from falling back and gravity carries it out above the level the sewer can reach. If the public sewer surcharges, there's no low opening for it to push through.

blocks.intro: Overhead systems make the most sense in homes that rely on gravity basement drains.

items.body: Many older homes near downtown have basements well below street level. In heavy rain, the floor drain is the first place water appears.
The July 2017 storms dropped more than 7 inches just south of Elgin over two days. Basements across the area flooded.
We camera your line before recommending a conversion. If roots or a break are the cause, a [sewer repair](/elgin/sewer-repair) may be all you need.

blocks.h2: Overhead Sewer Questions From Elgin Homeowners

items.q: Can an overhead sewer go in a 100-year-old basement?
items.preview: Usually, yes. Older foundations just need more planning.
items.answer: Usually, yes. Older basements can have thick stone or block walls and odd layouts, so we plan the pit location and pipe path carefully before quoting.

items.q: Does an overhead sewer stop groundwater?
items.preview: No. That's a sump pump's job.
items.answer: No. It stops sewer water from coming up through basement drains. Groundwater coming through walls or the floor needs a [sump pump](/elgin/sump-pumps).

items.q: Will my basement bathroom still work?
items.preview: Yes. It drains to the new pit.
items.answer: Yes. Basement bathrooms, laundry and bar sinks all drain to the ejector pit, and the pump sends everything out overhead.

items.q: How long does the installation take?
items.answer: Usually a few days, depending on the number of fixtures and how finished the basement is.

items.q: How much does an overhead sewer system cost in Elgin?
items.preview: It depends on your basement and line. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on sewer depth, basement layout, the number of fixtures and access. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
